name: Orzhov pontiff
description: A desperate Orzhov pontiff who runs an underground operation minting gold from copper and later fuses with his thrull.

description_citations.text: "Terrik". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A collapse traps the group in a subterranean corridor; tensions flare and they discover the pontiff's illegal gold-minting operation.
timeline.quote: found themselves trapped in a subterranean corridor after a collapse.

citation.text: "Terrik", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group is forced into labor; Terrik learns a spirit is Bazda's mother and destroys the pontiff's contract book, temporarily freeing the spirits.
timeline.quote: Terrik seized an opportunity to disrupt the operation by destroying the pontiff's contract book, temporarily freeing the spirits.

citation.text: "Terrik", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terrik pushes the pontiff into a pit; Ambrellin activates the machine, and Terrik pays off their debts, leaving the fused pontiff powerless.
timeline.quote: Terrik asserted their freedom by paying off their debts.

citation.text: "Terrik", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They find the pontiff's underground operation using Izzet technology to mint gold, and are forced into labor.
